## Usage Notes

- Send only after `matter_status = "completed"` is confirmed
- Review request section is **optional** — include only when matter went smoothly
- Do NOT include if there were execution complications or client complaints
- Do NOT offer incentives, discounts, or rewards for reviews
- Do NOT include fake review quotes or suggest specific rating language
- Do NOT include this template in automated flows — direct send only
- Google Review link must be the live, verified GBP review link
- Replace all `[BRACKETED]` fields with matter-specific data

---

## What NOT to Include

- Payment amounts or Wise references
- Internal matter notes or operator comments
- Discount information or pricing overrides
- Any guarantee of legal outcomes
- Any claim of embassy or government approval
- Referral incentive language
